wa_mount_crowder_northeast_ridge.approach: Reached only by first climbing Mount Crowder (typically via the Southwest Route/SW Flank from Wild Lake) and continuing down the far side; there is no separate trailhead approach to this ridge on its own.

approach_logistics.trailhead: No separate trailhead — over Mount Crowder (Southwest Route, Wild Lake)

road.name: North Cascades Highway (SR 20) to unpaved USFS access roads
road.status: SR 20 stays open essentially year-round on this western section; connecting USFS spur roads are seasonal.
road.driveNote: No road comes anywhere near this ridge; it is reached only after days of off-trail travel.
road.seasonalGate: USFS access roads typically aren't clear until after spring snowmelt, roughly June.

bivy.name: Pickell Pass
bivy.notes: Open camp at the pass at the foot of the ridge, used by traverse parties who climb Crowder from Wild Lake and descend this ridge to the pass.
bivy.permit: North Cascades NP backcountry permit (cross-country zone)

bivy.name: Wild Lake
bivy.notes: Remote lake below the southwest flank of Crowder, the start of the normal line up the peak before continuing down this ridge.
bivy.permit: North Cascades NP backcountry permit (cross-country zone)
